The '''''Grace of Chapalan Tides''''' was a [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class warship]] in service to the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. In [[3678 BBY]], the ''Grace of Chapalan Tides'' was under the command of a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Unidentified Republic Commodore|commodore]] and played host to a [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Jerbhen Hulis|Jedi Master]] and his [[Unidentified Padawan (Great Galactic War)|Padawan]] during their search for [[Exal Kressh]].

==Appearances==
*''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith]]'' {{1st}}
